description: Generates typed model classes from SQL DDL (CREATE TABLE statements). Supports TypeScript, C#, Go, Python, Java, Kotlin, Groovy, Scala, Swift, PHP, and Rust.

ddlSource.description: SQL DDL source code (CREATE TABLE statements)

dryRun.description: Preview mode - returns generated code without writing files to disk

generateInterfaces.description: Emit interface-style output (interface/protocol/trait) instead of the default modern-idiomatic concrete shape (record/data class/case class/struct).

generateNavigationProperties.description: Generate navigation properties for foreign key relationships

generateValidationAnnotations.description: Generate validation annotations from column constraints

initializeProperties.description: Initialize model properties with default values

jsonAs.description: How JSON columns are typed: e.g. 'string' (raw), 'object' (parsed). Language-specific defaults apply if omitted.

outputPath.description: Output directory path where files will be written

precisionSafeDecimals.description: Emit decimal/numeric columns as precision-safe types (e.g. string in JS) instead of float, preserving full precision.

schemaPrefix.description: Prepend the SQL schema name to generated type names (e.g. 'Auth_User' instead of 'User').

singularTypeNames.description: Singularize plural table names when emitting type names (e.g. table 'users' becomes type 'User').

skipExisting.description: Skip writing files that already exist

name: generate_sql
title: Generate Models from SQL DDL
